source.title: Estimates of station usage, April 2024 to March 2025, Table 1415a: time series of passenger entries and exits by station, Great Britain (published 4 December 2025)
source.table: Table 1415a, column 'Apr 2024 to Mar 2025', grouped by 'Region' (London) or 'Local authority: district or unitary'

rows.measure: entries and exits a year at the national rail stations inside the city
rows.note: Computed: the sum over 340 stations of the publisher's own station estimates, the stations the ORR places in the London region (Greater London, all 33 boroughs); the three largest: London Liverpool Street 98,015,658, London Waterloo 70,389,546, London Paddington 69,897,084; April 2024 to March 2025; a journey counts once where it enters and once where it leaves; national rail only (London Underground-only stations, trams and metros are not in the table; Elizabeth line and Overground stations are); the ORR's estimates come from ticket sales and local ticketing data
